notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
Additions:

Implemented multiple save slots, allowing players to save and load different progress files.

Introduced a free-fly camera that activates upon hero death in campaign mode.


Fixes & Improvements:

Resolved an issue where tooltips would remain stuck when upgrading a hero.

Fixed a bug where the Undead Draugr failed to deal damage during certain animations.

Corrected an animation bug with Goblin units.

Addressed an issue where units could spawn on top of the bridge in the Swamp scene.

Added language translations for all abilities (full translations for the rest of the game are coming soon).

notes.title: Early Access Hotfix 3
notes.content:
Hotfix Patch Notes

📈 Added Level 60 cap.

⚔️ Fixed Knight’s Slash ability collider so it now hits correctly.

🏰 Fixed bug where enemies could spawn on walls, they now no longer do that.

🎮 You can now start a New Game in Campaign directly from the Play Menu.

👻 Added a cooldown to Wraith Form ability.

⚡ Improved performance in Sandbox mode.

🏆 Fixed campaign victory prompt the “Press TAB to return to editor” message no longer shows up after winning. Only shows in Sandbox.

notes.title: Early Access Hotfix 2
notes.content:
Hotfix Patch Notes

🏰 Fixed Orcs spawning on top of castle walls — they now spawn correctly on the ground.

⚔️ Fixed dungeon death bug where characters could fall through the ground after dying.

🏹 You can now cancel aiming when firing projectiles by using Right-Click, Dodge, or Roll.

notes.title: Early Access Hotfix 1
notes.content:
Hotfix Patch Notes

🛠️ Fixed Orc hero buffs not applying correctly.

🛡️ Fixed Paladin’s health upgrade to now work as intended.

☠️ Fixed Necromancer’s Raise Dead ability no longer kills summons.

notes.title: Lords & Legions — Early Access Begins
notes.content:
🎮 Release Event Announcement: Lords & Legions
Prepare yourself — war arrives on 23 September 2025! Lords & Legions, the medieval fantasy battle sandbox from Warborne Studios, is launching on Steam in Early Access — and we want you to be part of its forging.
[hr][/hr]What to Expect
Command from the Front — Take control of a heroic champion in third-person combat. Your hero’s abilities, strengths, and choices matter.

Lead Armies, Shape Legends — Start small, grow your forces, train units, gather gold, and prepare for epic castle sieges and massive battlefield confrontations.

Campaign Mode + Roguelike Map Traversal — Every run is different. Random encounters, opportunity & risk, and escalating challenges as you push further into hostile territory.

Sandbox Mode — No rules other than those you make. Design your own battles: choose terrain, weather, unit types, army size. Relive cinematic clashes or craft wild, chaotic warfare.

Living Development with You in Mind — Player feedback will help shape balance, quest content, difficulty. We’ll expand with new biomes, support for new heroes, skill trees, new “Domination Mode,” and more as Early Access progresses.
[hr][/hr]Why Join on Day One?
Influence the direction of a distinctive hybrid: strategy + action RPG + large-scale warfare.

Forge your legend from scratch — feel your decisions carry weight, from hero growth to army command.

Be part of a community shaping something ambitious: unique maps, grand battles, varied biomes, evolving challenges.

Early Access pricing and content means what you see now will grow — being an early supporter gives you front row access to improvements and expansions.

[/td][/tr][/table][hr][/hr]How to Get Involved[olist]
Wishlist the Game on Steam now — get notified when we launch.

Follow Our Channels — We’re active on Discord & Steam forums, and we want your feedback.

Join the Launch Event — At release we’ll host AMAs, maybe stream, share behind-the-scenes, maybe contests & giveaways. (Stay tuned!)
[/olist][hr][/hr]
Mark the date, sharpen your blade, and prepare your strategies: Lords & Legions will be ready to test your mettle on 23 Sept 2025. Raise your banner, command your armies — the battlefield awaits.
